title: Everyone's doing the 'expose' poll
scenario: A poll app going around your grade asks you to rank classmates and answer questions about them, and says it needs access to your contacts to 'unlock' more questions.

answers.A: Answer the questions but skip the contacts permission.
answers.B: Don't use the app at all, and tell a friend why.
answers.C: Use it fully, including granting contacts access, since everyone else is.

explanation: These apps exist to harvest contact lists and produce content that turns into bullying - the 'everyone's doing it' pressure is the mechanism, not a reason it's safe.
proTip: An app that needs your contacts to work is collecting more than a poll answer.
